name: I-dolls
source:
【LIVE YOUR DREAM 🇰🇷】

You’re heading to South Korea for a year on a university exchange program. Your cousin and best friend, Claire, will be sharing this incredible experience right by your side. But Claire isn't just that: she also happens to be the sister of the leader of one of today’s biggest K-pop groups—3rd Star!

【RUB SHOULDERS WITH STARS ⭐️】
Once in Seoul, you’ll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in Korean culture to further your studies, but also to get up close and personal with the very stars you admire so much. Perhaps you’ll even get to discover what lies beneath the glitz and glamour... Incredible friendships await you—and maybe something more, if the sparks fly! Choose from Him-chan, Jinnie, Ja, and Haniel. ❤️️ (The other idols who appear in the game are not potential love interests or crushes.)

【DECIDE YOUR DESTINY 💟】
Your destiny is in your hands. For this journey won't exactly be smooth sailing, and you’ll encounter several obstacles along the way. What choices will you make? Will you choose love, despite the difficulties? Here, your decisions have a real impact on how the story unfolds—both in the short and long term.

[Translated from [url=https://shukimo-studio.itch.io/i-dolls-version-francaise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
【实现你的梦想🇰🇷】你将前往韩国参加一年的大学交换项目。你的表弟和最好的朋友克莱尔将在你身边分享这段令人难以置信的经历。但克莱尔不仅如此：她还恰好是当今最大的韩国流行乐队之一3rd Star的领导人的妹妹！

【与星星擦肩⭐️】到达首尔后，你将有机会沉浸在韩国文化中以继续深造，同时也可以与你所崇拜的明星近距离接触。也许你甚至会发现浮华和魅力之下隐藏着什么……令人难以置信的友谊等待着你——如果火花四溢，也许还有更多！从Him-chan、Jinnie、Ja和Haniel中选择。❤️️（游戏中出现的其他偶像并非潜在的恋爱对象或暗恋对象。）

【决定你的命运💟】你的命运掌握在你的手中。因为这段旅程不会一帆风顺，一路上你会遇到一些障碍。你会做出什么选择？尽管困难重重，你会选择爱情吗？在这里，你的决定会对故事的展开产生真正的影响——无论是短期还是长期。

[译自[url=https://shukimo-studio.itch.io/i-dolls-version-francaise]Itch.io[/url]]
